rules.description: Authenticated normal users begin strictly at NOT_APPLIED
Email, Google, or GitHub authentication never confers Expert role
5-star rating never confers Expert authority or moderator eligibility
Minimum 20 independent adjudicated units required before reliability projection
Idempotency key deduplication, correlated cluster event normalization, self-review denial
Direct client inserts on community_perception_* and moderation_* blocked via RLS (SQLSTATE 42501)
Client attempt to force voter_is_expert_at_vote = true is overridden/denied by server authority
